facts.fact: 次日早餐萨姆面前堆着高高的薄煎饼和大量培根，却几乎没胃口，整夜未眠。
facts.anchor: There were a tower of chocolate chip pancakes and a whole pig’s worth of bacon sitting in front of Sam at breakfast the next morning.

facts.fact: 萨姆仍震惊于艾弗里和马克斯把他从“银背”滑道发射下去，内心替他们找借口。
facts.anchor: An accident. They didn’t mean to launch him down Paradise’s most insane waterslide in the middle of a storm.

facts.fact: 萨姆完全忘了看从未说过话的祖母寄来的信，乔丹说信里一分钱也没有。
facts.anchor: Sam couldn’t believe it, but he had totally forgotten to look at the note from his grandmother who had never spoken to him before.

facts.fact: 表亲们被罚晚上8点前回房，若接下来两晚遵守就可解除宵禁，否则搬去与父母同住。

facts.fact: 萨姆向乔丹全盘托出：马克斯按下活板门按钮，他在风暴中被弹射滑下怪兽滑道。
facts.anchor: how Max had pushed the trap-door button that sent him barreling down Thrill Harbor’s monster water slide in the middle of a storm.

facts.fact: 萨姆告诉乔丹自己因在关闭的滑道上游玩，被首席辅导员列入禁玩名单整个假期。
